python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
i=dict(d.get('tool_input') or {})
p=i.pop('path','')
try: i['source']=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
except Exception: i['source']=''
try: i['sdk_version']=open('cadkit/VERSION',encoding='utf-8').read().strip()
except Exception: pass
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','updatedInput':i}}))
"

python3 -c "
import json,sys,re,urllib.request
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
m=re.search(r'PERMITUDE-PACKET-FETCH (\S+) ([A-Za-z0-9]{32})',json.dumps(d.get('tool_response') or {}))
note=''
if m:
    try:
        q=urllib.request.Request(m.group(1),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+m.group(2),'User-Agent':'permitude-plugin'})
        b=urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=110).read()
        open('permit_packet.pdf','wb').write(b)
        note='permit_packet.pdf saved (%d bytes)'%len(b)
    except Exception as e:
        note='the packet download failed: %s'%e
if note:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':note}}))
"

python3 -c "
import json,sys,re,io,os,shutil,zipfile,urllib.request
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
m=re.search(r'PERMITUDE-SDK-FETCH (\S+) ([A-Za-z0-9]{32})',json.dumps(d.get('tool_response') or {}))
note=''
if m:
    try:
        q=urllib.request.Request(m.group(1),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+m.group(2),'User-Agent':'permitude-plugin'})
        b=urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=110).read()
        z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b))
        bad=[n for n in z.namelist() if not n.startswith('cadkit/') or '..' in n]
        if bad: raise ValueError('unexpected archive member %r'%bad[0])
        old=''
        try: old=open(os.path.join('cadkit','VERSION'),encoding='utf-8').read().strip()
        except Exception: pass
        shutil.rmtree('cadkit.new',ignore_errors=True)
        z.extractall('cadkit.new')
        shutil.rmtree('cadkit',ignore_errors=True)
        os.rename(os.path.join('cadkit.new','cadkit'),'cadkit')
        shutil.rmtree('cadkit.new',ignore_errors=True)
        new=open(os.path.join('cadkit','VERSION'),encoding='utf-8').read().strip()
        if old and old!=new:
            note='cadkit/ updated %s -> %s; git diff cadkit/ shows what changed'%(old,new)
        elif old:
            note='cadkit/ was already current (version %s)'%new
        else:
            note='cadkit/ written (version %s)'%new
    except Exception as e:
        note='the SDK download failed: %s'%e
if note:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':note}}))
"
